message.content: LiHua believes that Lionel Messi's exceptional skills extend beyond just his dribbling ability. He considers Messi's playmaking ability to be on another level, praising his vision and creativity on the field. LiHua also highlights Messi's work ethic and humility as qualities that inspire others, emphasizing how these traits have influenced future generations of soccer players. He mentions Messi's consistent performance and dedication throughout his career, noting that these factors contribute significantly to why Messi is widely regarded as the best in the world.
